claim.quote: The NA61/SHINE collaboration studies at the CERN Super Proton Synchrotron (SPS) the onset of deconfinement in hadronic matter by the measurement of particle production in collisions of nuclei with various sizes at a set of energies covering the SPS energy range.

name: NA61/SHINE pi- production in 7Be+9Be at 19A to 150A GeV/c

summary.plain: NA61/SHINE measured how many negatively charged pions are produced in beryllium-beryllium collisions across beam energies from 19 to 150 GeV per nucleon, part of its search for where quark-gluon plasma formation sets in.
summary.technical: Spectra and mean multiplicities of pi- in 7Be+9Be collisions at beam momenta 19A, 30A, 40A, 75A and 150A GeV/c, compared with models and with p+p and Pb+Pb data in the energy scan of the onset of deconfinement.

title: Measurements of pi- production in 7Be+9Be collisions at beam momenta from 19A to 150A GeV/c in the NA61/SHINE experiment at the CERN SPS
why_it_matters: Together with p+p and central Pb+Pb data, the system-size scan locates the changes in energy dependence interpreted as the onset of deconfinement.
